native_instances.description: His mushroom cloud of beard hair is powdered with all the abrasions of the trash sea: white lime, red iron, gold filament, opalescent shavings of the plastiglomerate. Chrome joints and pieces of scrap crystal are hooked to pockets lining his torso, and one of his bushy eyebrows is perpetually cocked, though whether that's a symptom of an insatiable curiosity or forehead mutation is unknown.

native_instances.description:
A warm smile spreads over an old face freckled by time and a million crumbs of salt. He shrinks under a hunched back and drums the ground beneath him with a short and barb-crowned tail. A second pair of arms rise over the slump of his shoulders, where hands meet and fingers lace to form another face, this one vacant and prehistoric, no mouth and eyes desert-white.
{{C|-----}}
Loved by {{C|the villagers of Joppa}}.

Hated by {{C|the villagers of Kiggashur}} for questioning the origins of the moon.

Disliked by {{C|goatfolk}} for casting doubt on their beliefs.

Admired by {{C|the Daughters of Exile}} for respecting the sanctity of a burial site.

native_instances.description:
He is a wind-carved man with the posture of a vinereaper; his spine is bent to point the bright turquoise of his eyes at the tilling angle, his hips are pushed odd-forward with the slumping ease of a stance much more relaxed than his. If it weren't for the salt on his brow and the scarred knuckles, he would seem a marble Saad perched under a crumbling tomb.
{{C|-----}}
Loved by {{C|the villagers of Joppa}}.

Disliked by {{C|the Seekers of the Sightless Way}} for leading a raiding party on one of their camps.

Disliked by {{C|mysterious strangers}} for torching one of their villages.

native_instances.description:
Big Yrame shifts her weight between hind and forelegs. She shakes a storm of rust dander from the tines of her great horns, and she blows a halo of freezing air from her rime-veined hands.

Admired by {{C|the villagers of Joppa}} for defending their village.

Disliked by {{C|the villagers of Tuwan}} for disparaging a famous poet.

Disliked by {{C|trees}} for eating one of their young.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A table scorched with the radial patterns of hot chemistry holds a phial rack and alembic.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Slide drawers of galvanized metal are arranged in a cabinet as rectangles of assorted dimensions. Storage is fractal.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A terracotta board has been painted with ochre and ground iron.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Fabrics were stuffed with watervine chaff and laid across wooden slats in the style of the hillfolk.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A goat wool bed fastened with canvas ties.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Dwellers in the earth-clefts fashion tables in the style of puzzle boxes. Their drawers house the stenographic imagination.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A bridge made of dried brinestalk.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Girthy pilings of fibrous salt-rot stake out these pools of brine. They belong to no one.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Salt-tracing waves cross the grain on the brinestalk pickets stuck into the ground.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Here are several stripped trunks of sallow brinestalk bonded with mud.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Cyclopean blades shaped to the airfoil are housed inside a metallic ring nicked with the scars of time. In the distant past, someone directed the course of air at grand scales.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A jug of aluminum has been sheathed in an olive green cloth for waterkeeping.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Jointed wood and knit watervine make a movable wharf for the ass.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: The quickened flax of the earth was duck-weaved in a simple square pattern and hung up on pickets.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Planks of wood are nailed together at right angles in the style of the marsh dwellers.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A wood storage box with a hinged lid and latch. Notches scratched on the surface hint at the full probability array of language, and also its absence.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A tangled nest of roots spill through the earth. The bark is splintered into pointy spines. The leaves are greasy and stinking.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: The slate is touched with years of handprints and a ring of rust flakes off the top of the hinges. The door continues, though, its stubborn assertion of 'in' and 'out'.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Wood was precisely cut into drawers and set on brass rails to house clothes.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A cased rotor is fed charge through a handcrank and supplemented by solar heat. Its scratched metal surfaces vibrate at ground frequency.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Stuffed with watervine chaff and glowcrow feathers, this buttoned pillow lets folk repose with crossed legs.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Pieces of the old and aching world have been shaved off their timepoint and crushed to the vicinity of the present. A few bits of recognition remain:  lens of glass, serif of ink, acid-ate lug, and ribbon of wire.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Brinestraw was braided into a rope lattice saddle for slinging between two old oaks and napping. The fibers on the middle-sag are extra frayed from the center-mass strain of a reclining ass.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Wood planks are nailed at orthogonal angles, and dust sleeps on the paper jackets.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A terracotta board has been painted with ochre and ground iron.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A terracotta board has been painted with ochre and ground iron.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of hot starapple jam and toasted matz.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Handwheel and spindle turn to sand off matter and gift the world with helices and round things. Metal dust accrues on the ground beneath.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Magnetized innards digest electrical signals and belch out the waveform, while a diaphragm breaths dust onto a brass grill.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: The biped form emerges out of a cocoon of wood and fiberglass.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Steel was anointed with liquid chrome, cooled, and beaten into a flat and workable surface.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Circles of limestone, porous and oyster-gray with the shells of old things, are arranged in vertical slabs and turned against each other to grind fibrous grains into flours.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Etched chromium on the lavish legs tapers to claw-and-ball feet, and on the marble surface, geometric imperfections were rasped off and flung into an iron bucket that may still exist somewhere. Eaters spoke here, and planned.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Nacreous oil wets the ecru linen and has dripped onto the easel. From the plane of the canvas, an image is pressed out.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A terracotta board has been painted with ochre and ground iron.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A pool of liquid.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Two copper bulbs form a spark gap that facilitates current along a path of ionized gas. The thing snaps and sparks at you.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A vessel of freeblown glass curves at the lunar arc. The style hints that it originates from the coast of the Fuming God Sea, on the far side of Moghra'yi, and that it was likely exported by the dromads.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Sheet metal is locked in diamond pattern and welded to enclose. The surface is scorched and scratched in sections.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A piece of scrap was shed or peeled off a machine fossil.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A piece of scrap was shed or peeled off a machine fossil.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Inside the scratched metal C a needle and a bobbin prepare to punch a pair of threads into a lockstitch. Initials are carved all around its pedestal.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Starapples hang from ashen branches, motes of luscious, red light in a bleached tableau.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Starapples hang from ashen branches, motes of luscious, red light in a bleached tableau.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Branches of the living tree were resorbed and reformed into trunk knots. Then, hundreds of years later, the oiled saw of a gorge woodworker disarranged the arbor geometry and flattened it for civil use. That history remains cast in two dimensions, powdered with dust and scratched in pencil.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A brightly burning handfire hangs across wood and iron.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A large storage vase with a decorative slip. The style hints that it was fired in the home-kiln of a canyon dweller.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Salt gathers in its furrows. It's knotted with moisture-swollen wafers in place of leaves.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: A large storage vase with a decorative slip. The style hints that it was fired in the home-kiln of a canyon dweller.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Wood paddles black with wet-rot catch the force of the babbling brook and set the wheel to the slow motion of centuries.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Wood was shaved, cut to smooth-volumed shafts, and fit inside gearboxes to convey motion in continuity.

description.Name: Description
description.Short: Marsh reed was handcrossed by warp and weft into a vessel for sheaf and other dry goods.
